query: Chimaja Appawas the younger brother of a general of the Maratha Empire in India, who served as what to the fifth Maratha Chhatrapati Shahu from 1720 until his death?

pipeline_result.response: Chimajaja Appa was the younger brother of Bajirao Peshwa, who served as the "Peshwa" (Prime Minister) to the fifth Maratha Chhatrapati Shahu from 1720 until his death. Chimajaja Appa was an able military commander known for liberating the western coast of India from Portuguese rule and capturing the Vasai fort in a hard-fought battle.
retrieved_context: Chimaji Appa: Shreemant Chimaji Ballal Peshwa (aka Chimaji Appa)(1707–1740) was the son of Balaji Vishwanath Bhat and the younger brother of Bajirao Peshwa of Maratha Empire.  He was an able military commander who liberated the western coast of India from Portuguese rule.  The high watermark of his career was the capture of Vasai fort from the Portuguese in a hard fought battle.

Baji Rao I: Baji Rao (18 August 1700 – 28 April 1740) was a general of the Maratha Empire in India.  He served as "Peshwa" (Prime Minister) to the fifth Maratha Chhatrapati (Emperor) Shahu from 1720 until his death.  He is also known by the name Bajirao Ballal.
